# SSE — core-hub: what shingo-core/www/static/app.js does with the shared bus on import
# (its onSSE("system-status") subscription keeps one stream open on every Core page).

a Core page imports app.js
    t=0 open #1 /events?topics=system-status
    #1 listens for: connected, heartbeat, system-status
#1 ← connected {"build":"b1"}
    (nothing)
#1 ← system-status {"fleet":"ok"}
    (nothing)
#1 error
    t=0 close #1
    t=1000 open #2 /events?topics=system-status
    = #2 opened 1000 ms after #1 closed
#2 ← connected {"build":"b2"}  (Core redeployed)
    t=1000 refresh banner shown
    the banner:
      div id="shingo-refresh-banner" role="status" style="position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:var(--z-toast);background:#fff3cd;border-bottom:1px solid #ffe69c;color:#664d03;padding:0.6rem 1rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.75rem;justify-content:center;font-size:0.95rem;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)"
        span
          "A new version is available."
        button style="padding:0.3rem 0.9rem;background:#0d6efd;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600" listens=click
          "Refresh"
        button style="padding:0.3rem 0.7rem;background:transparent;color:#664d03;border:1px solid #c9a85e;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer" listens=click
          "Dismiss"
a page module subscribes onSSE("order-update") after the stream is up
    t=1000 close #2
    t=1000 open #3 /events?topics=order-update%2Csystem-status
#3 error: what the page shows while it is down
    t=1000 close #3
    = elements in the page before the drop 7, 10 ms into it 7
